faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes SLK320 use?
faqLeft.a: The SLK320 uses the M112 3.2-litre V6 petrol engine. It was fitted from 1996 to 2004 in the R170 generation. Later V6 SLK models (R171/R172) are the SLK350 with the M272 — a different engine entirely.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes SLK320 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £3,200. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my SLK320?
faqLeft.a: If you have a genuine SLK320, it has the M112. If your car is from 2004 onwards and has a V6, it's likely an SLK350 (M272) rather than an SLK320. Enter your registration and we'll confirm your exact spec.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M112 SLK320 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, bearings and gaskets as standard on every M112 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M272 V6 SLK engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes — the M272 is fitted to SLK350 models (R171/R172), and we service it to the same high standard.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used SLK320 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my SLK320 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an SLK320 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most SLK320 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
